notes.title: Update! #1
notes.content:
Gameplay changes:
[list]
[*]Increased prestige points gain speed
[*]Damage from generators will be paused until a new cube appears if the previous one was destroyed
[*]Doubled the maximum number of clicks per second limit
[*]Set maximum values for interest upgrades
[*]Changed prices for some interest upgrades from money to prestige points
[*]Changed interest rates for some upgrades
[/list]
